Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed character creation by conflating Francis Ford Coppola’s co-writing of the film screenplay with the creation of the characters. Despite sources indicating Mario Puzo created the characters (e.g., Michael and Vito Corleone) in the 1969 novel, the Planner concluded that the main characters were “co-created by Mario Puzo and Francis Ford Coppola,” leading to the incorrect final answer.
